protocol.source: five right-16x32 runs; first policy query per episode
protocol.probability_distance: root-mean-square Hellinger over aligned HB layer, denoise, and action-token sites after full 32-way L1 normalization
protocol.expert_id_distance: mean order-invariant top-4 Jaccard distance over aligned HB layer, denoise, and action-token sites
protocol.tokens: action tokens 1-10 only; state token excluded
protocol.random_baseline: exact K32 within-state mean eventual rollout success
protocol.opportunity: max observed K32 success minus exact K32 mean success
protocol.bootstrap: states resampled independently within each task; task macro then averaged
protocol.task_heldout_dispersion_model: posthoc one-feature OLS trained on four tasks and tested on the fifth

limitations: Each candidate has one eventual episode outcome and no common-random-number continuation repeats.
The first-query route is associated with a full episode seed stream; later replanning noise also changes with that seed.
The medoid is a shadow selector requiring all K32 routes and was not executed online.
Only 80 independent state pools and five tasks are available; saturated tasks make opportunity correlations undefined.
Task-heldout dispersion fits are exploratory and were not preregistered.
